##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 20 June 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure building to extend a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, becoming variable later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east at first, falling smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of mist and fog patches in the east at first.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, becoming north or northeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
